title: The Sieved Mirror Kernel Phi_X(u), the Zero-Free Exponential Prime-Gauge Factor E_X(z), and Quadratic Prime-Power Purity on (X, X^2] for Riemann's Xi-Function
description: Paper VI of the series on the Transverse Wronskian of Riemann's Xi-Function. Establishes the holomorphic sieved mirror kernel Phi_X(u) in |Im(u)| < pi/8, the 3x3 Schur-complement optimal mollifier filter P_opt(x), the entire zero-free exponential prime-gauge factor E_X(z) with bijective zero preservation and quadratic prime-power purity on (X, X^2], the exact negative hyperbolic mirror weight w_n*(d_0) = -(n^{2d_0}-1)^{-1} without waterbed tail, power-law L^2 diagonal damping X^{-2d}/(2d ln X) with universal Sub-Selberg closure theta_E^{sq}(d,t) < 1/2 across the critical strip, the exact finite-divisor identity on [1, N(t)] with composite-gap Gaussian tail suppression, and the shifted self-mirrored prime-gauge factor E_{X,kappa}(z) with exact outer factorization.
